description: Restructure the high-batch n=256/512/1024/2048 paths into a persistent factor-solve-update task queue with cluster or global dependency counters. Keep B200 SMs fed across matrices and stages, fuse panel conversion/output emission, and replace underfilled 64-120-CTA tail waves while preserving low-batch and large-N dispatches, caller-stream semantics, caches, and fresh inputs.

Persistent 148-CTA n256 tail queue interleaving three middle updates with per-matrix final solve/update/factor via global completion counters; full-grid 807.503 us, n256 193.995 us versus measured parent 105.796 us.

Fixed-role 128-CTA n256 dependency queue: 128 first middle tasks, 64 remaining producers, and 64 per-matrix final consumers waiting on fenced counters; full-grid 753.349 us, n256 83.807 us versus measured parent 105.796 us.

Profile-guided 256-CTA n256 dependency queue with 192 one-task middle producers and 64 resident final consumers; fused counter reset into middle solve. Hosted profile of prior trial showed 86.94 us queue, 4.52% SM busy, 0.17 waves. Full-grid 748.014 us; n256 77.825 us.

Split n256 dependency queue into concurrent 192-CTA producer and 64-CTA counter-wait consumer kernels on captured side streams to reduce combined-kernel instruction footprint; full-grid 753.726 us, n256 80.388 us, slower than dccf245's 748.014/77.825 us.

Three-stage n256 counter pipeline: concurrent 128-CTA middle solve, 192-CTA update, and 64-CTA final kernels with per-matrix solve/update counters across captured streams; full-grid 757.815 us, n256 86.277 us, slower than dccf245.

Restored dccf245 n256 queue and released all eight independent n2048 sample chains from one start event instead of gating four behind first-panel events; full-grid 763.920 us, n2048 batch8 1845.413 us, no measured gain over staggered scheduling.

Batched all eight n2048 matrices through shared 8/592/... CTA inner factor-solve-update stages, batched cuBLAS outer TRSM, and batched CuTe rank-k instead of eight stream-local sample chains. Full-grid 745.304 us; n2048 batch8 1783.667 us; worst sample-run spike 9.1 ms vs 63.2 ms prior.

Expanded batch60 n1024 256x256 factor from two to three CTAs per matrix (180 CTAs) with tokenized panel-arrival bitmasks; full-grid 776.388 us, n1024 batch60 1253.490 us versus 910.838 us at 960b2a1, showing large resident-wait/resource regression.

Restored two-CTA n1024 factor and removed each outer stage's 60x256x256 gather by transposed/coalesced reads directly from strided full-output diagonals into compact factor/sidecar storage; full-grid 760.867 us, n1024 batch60 937.761 us versus 910.838 us with gather.

Restored gathered n1024 factor and routed batch640 n512 through the generic cuSOLVER batched library dispatch instead of one-CTA MathDx matrices; full-grid 836.976 us, n512 batch640 3011.866 us versus approximately 970-1044 us custom.

One 144-CTA persistent DAG per n2048 outer panel: eight factor coordinators, four panel workers and thirteen update workers per sample, fenced monotonic dependency counters, and fused first outer-panel copy. Restored n512/n1024 to 960b2a1 state. Full-grid 841.479 us; n2048 batch8 1948.198 us versus 1783.667 us at 960b2a1; n256 also had one 68.98 ms spike.

Reused all seventeen non-coordinator CTAs per n2048 sample for both panel and update phases instead of dedicating 4/13 roles, keeping 136 task workers active behind eight factor coordinators. Full-grid 746.085 us; n2048 batch8 1790.800 us versus 1948.198 us for the split-role queue and 1783.667 us at 960b2a1.

Fused paired 32x16 n2048 trailing updates into one 32x32 MathDx GEMM task, halving the persistent queue's update graph and using an 8 KiB full-tile operand layout with 100% shared carveout. Full-grid 746.827 us; n2048 batch8 1718.022 us versus 1790.800 us for the half-tile queue and 1783.667 us at 960b2a1.

Fused each batch60 n1024 64-row panel group's S0/U1/S1/U2/S2/U3/S3 sequence into one CTA-resident chain, reducing panel launches from 21 to 3 while retaining compact factor/half sidecars and rank-k boundaries. Full-grid 747.610 us; n1024 batch60 893.089 us versus 907.969-910.838 us before fusion; n2048 batch8 measured 1788.270 us in this noisy run.

Kept each fused n1024 panel update accumulator in shared memory for its immediate triangular solve, removing three FP32 store/reload pairs per row task while retaining one launch per outer stage. Full-grid 751.530 us; n1024 batch60 mean 987.188 us with best 864.224 us and one 24.49 ms spike, versus prior fused-chain mean 893.089 us; n2048 batch8 1758.648 us.

Raised the shared-limited n1024 fused-chain bulk/middle register caps to 72 to match the tail and reduce spill pressure without changing the approximately three-CTA shared-memory residency. Full-grid 763.025 us; n1024 batch60 901.244 us (best sample 876.352 us) versus 987.188 us under 48/64 caps; n2048 batch8 1720.389 us; n256 had a 7.87 ms spike.

Removed 64 spin-wait n256 tail consumers: the last-arriving one of each sample's three fenced middle-update CTAs now performs the final solve/update/factor in-block, reducing the queue from 256 to 192 CTAs. Full-grid 752.842 us; n256 mean 93.427 us, best 73.978 us, worst 3887.886 us; n1024/n2048 907.515/1724.354 us.

Reduced n2048 persistent queue task workers from 17 to 16 per sample, preserving all 14 panel tasks and full-tile updates while removing eight barrier/spin participants. New full-grid best 744.796 us versus 745.304 us at 960b2a1; n256/n1024/n2048 batch8 were 79.245/891.367/1701.666 us.

Reduced n2048 queue task workers from 16 to 15 as the next structured sweep point. Full-grid 747.992 us; n2048 batch8 1731.777 us versus 1701.666 us with 16 workers; n1024 batch60 885.211 us and n256 88.246 us including outliers. The 16-worker point remains measured faster.

Restored 16 n2048 task workers and made only CTAs with actual work publish completion atomics, reducing per-sample panel/update completions from 112/112 to 56/67 while preserving monotonic dependency thresholds. New full-grid best 741.334 us versus 744.796 us at cd6c52ff; n256/n1024/n2048 were 76.927/883.604/1727.238 us.

Published a separate per-tile diagonal frontier token so n2048 factor coordinators could factor k+1 while off-diagonal updates from k continued; panel workers still waited for the complete prior update phase. Full-grid 752.102 us; n2048 batch8 1767.190 us versus 1727.238 us at bd4c9a83, showing overlap contention/synchronization cost; n1024 887.307 us.

Restored bd4c9a83's fully ordered active-completion queue and removed first-panel copy work from the eight factor coordinators; sixteen task workers copied each outer panel while factors began immediately. Full-grid 746.502 us; n2048 batch8 1731.913 us versus 1727.238 us at bd4c9a83; n1024 895.114 us.

Fused compact n1024 factor emission directly into the final output and zeroed strict-upper entries during initial lower-copy and factor-tile stores, removing four factor-copy/pointer-preparation launches while restoring bd4c9a83 n2048 queue behavior. Full-grid 746.090 us; n1024 batch60 959.990 us versus 883.604 us at bd4c9a83; n2048 batch8 1720.400 us.

Replaced scattered n1024 factor-output writes with a linked-device float4 transposed emitter and limited upper-zero stores to diagonal tiles. Build and full validation passed, but the ranked batch60 n1024 benchmark raised CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS from an out-of-range address before shape 7 completed; no full-grid metric.

Replaced the linked float4 emitter with bounds-audited scalar row-coalesced n1024 output writes directly from the transposed MathDx shared tile. Build and full validation passed, but ranked batch60 n1024 again raised CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS before shape 7 completed; no full-grid metric.

Restored the lean two-CTA n1024 factor kernel and added a 16-block-per-sample stage emitter that shared-transposed the compact factor into the output diagonal and zeroed that stage upper. Build and full validation passed, but ranked batch60 n1024 again raised CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS before shape 7 completed; no full-grid metric.

Fixed the accidental batch1024 half-tile loader overrun while retaining the lean factor kernel and 16-block-per-sample shared-transpose stage emitter. Full-grid 748.200 us; n1024 batch60 886.400 us versus 883.604 us at bd4c9a83 and 959.990 us for serialized direct emission; n2048 batch8 measured 1772.805 us.

Zeroed the cached batch60 n1024 output once before graph construction and removed recurring strict-upper stores from the captured lower-copy; the stage emitter still clears diagonal uppers repopulated by triangular rank-k. New full-grid best 740.729 us versus 741.334 us at bd4c9a83; n1024 batch60 improved to 861.537 us from 886.400 us in trial 26; n2048 batch8 measured 1767.536 us.

Best validated result is trial 27 commit 60576856bb0c3aef977bb908cc3f0af3c605c240 at 740.729 us, improving trial 19 bd4c9a83 at 741.334 us. The winning change retained the lean two-CTA n1024 factor queue plus a 16-block-per-sample coalesced stage emitter, zeroed cached output once, and removed recurring captured upper-zero traffic; n1024 batch60 measured 861.537 us. Other measured queue changes included active-only n2048 completions, 16-worker n2048 task waves, fused n1024 panel chains, full-tile n2048 updates, and n256 winner-completes-tail scheduling. Open directions include retaining four compact n1024 factors for one final emitter launch, double-buffered emitter overlap, fusing factor gather with stage emission, reducing stage-emitter upper-zero work to rank-k-touched tiles, and combining the n1024 win with lower-noise n2048 worker/task variants. Local final profiling is waived by the run layout; the approved hosted capture remains archived.
